full_judgment: 5. Now, by the State Acquisition and Tenancy (Amendment) Act, 2023, the appellate forum has been established and on 23-7-2023, the name of the Land Survey Appellate Tribunal, has been Gazetted. In the circumstances, this Court delivered a judgment and order on 4-12-2023 analogously disposing of Writ Petition Nos. 5135 of 2018, 12559 of 2022, 11772 of 2022, 3743 of 2018, 12797 of 2022, 16281 of 2016, 2210 of 2022 and 7203 of 2022 allowing the respective writ petitioners to prefer appeals before the newly established Land Survey Appellate Tribunals of the respective districts with a direction to the Land Survey Appellate Tribunal to consider their appeals and applications for condonation of delay, if filed, in accordance with section 14 read with section 29 of the Limitation Act.
